post.description:
Browse or rank players by 9-category stats in a public league. Pass stat_period explicitly (S_AS_2025 = 2025-26 per-game averages, S_S_2026 = 2026-27 season totals, S_AL14 = last 14 days averages, S_PS7 = next 7 days projected, S_PSR = rest of season projected). Sort by OR (pre-season rank), AR (current rank), R_PO (% rostered), MPG, NAME or a stat id (5 FG%, 8 FT%, 10 3PTM, 12 PTS, 15 REB, 16 AST, 17 ST, 18 BLK, 19 TO). For rank windows use player_rankings.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

Averages: S_AL7, S_AL14, S_AL30, S_AS_{season}. Standard deviation: S_SDL7, S_SDL14, S_SDL30, S_SD_{season}. {season} is the starting year (2025 = 2025-26).
